title: AutoSFT: An Agentic System for Automated Data Research in Supervised Fine-Tuning
title_zh: AutoSFT：一种用于监督微调中自动化数据研究的智能体系统

paragraphs.en: Language model agents increasingly automate post-training, but when given the full training stack they converge on supervised fine-tuning and spend most effort revising training data. Existing systems give the agent one kind of control, selecting rows from a fixed pool or calling a generator, whereas a human data engineer adjusts proportions, prunes, repairs, replaces and synthesizes the data. We design a data action space for these changes and ask whether an automated system can make the full range rather than one of them, and what structure that requires. We first run this loop with a single agent, and it reaches only one action, adjusting category proportions, while its context fills with execution output and is discarded mid-search. We therefore introduce AutoSFT , a multi-agent system where a meta agent separates execution from analysis, gathers proposals from independent angles, and calls a synthesis subagent for capabilities the pool cannot cover, with the model, the trainer, and the budget fixed within each comparison. Adding each component in turn helps: the executor halves context loss, the analysis subagents lift the best IFEval by + 6.5 +6.5 , and synthesis adds + 3.4 +3.4 IFEval and + 2.9 +2.9 IFBench. The same loop transfers to code, where analysis adds + 3.7 +3.7 MBPP+ over a single agent that does not improve. Every result comes from runs that retrain from the base model each round, so each component’s effect is individually attributable. Our findings suggest that automating SFT data research depends more on covering diverse data actions than on a stronger single action.

paragraphs.en: LLM agents now run long workflows with little human oversight, and several systems use them to automate parts of AI research itself [ Lu et al., 2026 , Tang et al., 2025 , Hu et al., 2025 , Wen et al., 2026 ] . What makes such a loop searchable is that every proposal can be evaluated automatically, and post-training has this property, so recent benchmarks evaluate agents on it [ Rank et al., 2026 , Chen et al., 2026a ] . Given control of the whole training stack, agents converge on one part: across the runs audited by PostTrainBench [ Rank et al., 2026 ] , they adopt supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and spend most of their remaining effort revising the training data. This agrees with a broader finding that a carefully curated dataset can match or outperform a much larger one [ Zhou et al., 2023a , Chen et al., 2024 , Muennighoff et al., 2025 ] , and that data selection and arrangement affect downstream performance directly [ He et al., 2025a , Agarwal et al., 2025 ] . Recent systems therefore treat the data as the main search object [ Wu et al., 2026 , Luo et al., 2026 , Zhao et al., 2026 , Kulikov et al., 2026 ] .
paragraphs.zh: LLM智能体现在能够以极少的监督运行长时间的工作流，并且已有多个系统利用它们来自动化人工智能研究本身的部分环节 [ Lu et al., 2026 , Tang et al., 2025 , Hu et al., 2025 , Wen et al., 2026 ] 。 使这种循环具备可搜索性的关键在于，每个提案都可以被自动评估，而训练后阶段恰好具有这一特性，因此近期的基准测试也据此对智能体进行了评估 [ Rank et al., 2026 , Chen et al., 2026a ] 。 在能够控制整个训练流程的前提下，智能体的注意力会集中在一个环节上：根据PostTrainBench [ Rank et al., 2026 ] 审计的运行结果，它们会采用监督微调（SFT），并将剩余的大部分精力用于修订训练数据。 这一发现与更广泛的研究结论一致，即精心挑选的数据集可以媲美甚至超越规模大得多的数据集 [ Zhou et al., 2023a , Chen et al., 2024 , Muennighoff et al., 2025 ] ，并且数据的选择与组织方式会直接影响下游任务的表现 [ He et al., 2025a , Agarwal et al., 2025 ] 。 因此，近期的系统都将数据视为主要的搜索对象 [ Wu et al., 2026 , Luo et al., 2026 , Zhao et al., 2026 , Kulikov et al., 2026 ] 。

paragraphs.en: We first study this question with a single agent, restarting each round from the same base checkpoint. The agent collapses onto one action family, repeats related recipes, and spends most of its context on raw command output rather than data analysis. Section 3 examines these failures, the trace evidence, and our fix, explaining why an undivided research loop is hard to sustain. One agent analyzes behavior, proposes data changes, executes experiments, and interprets logs, so execution competes with analysis for context and a single proposal stream reinforces recent choices. This yields two requirements: isolate execution from data analysis, and maintain complementary views of the same model behavior during proposal generation.
paragraphs.zh: 我们首先使用单个智能体来研究这个问题，每轮都从同一个基础检查点重新开始。 该智能体会固着于单一动作类别，重复相关的配方，并将大部分上下文资源用于原始命令输出，而非数据分析。 第 3 节将探讨这些失败现象、其痕迹证据以及我们的解决方案，并解释为何难以维持一个未分割的研究循环。 单个智能体既要分析行为、提出数据变更方案、执行实验，又要解读日志，因此执行过程会与分析过程争夺上下文资源，而单一提案流则会强化近期的选择。 由此产生两个要求：将执行过程与数据分析隔离开来，并在生成提案期间保持对同一模型行为的互补性视角。

paragraphs.en: AutoSFT ( Section 4 ) is a multi-agent system built around these two requirements. A meta agent owns each round and delegates to three kinds of subagent. An executor runs training, conversion, and evaluation separately, returning file paths and a short status report so the meta agent can spend its context on data. Analysis subagents read the same round from four angles: training data, failures, training signals, and earlier rounds, each returning one proposed data action. A synthesis subagent writes new data for capabilities the pool barely covers, which neither of the first two can add.

paragraphs.en: We frame automated SFT data research around a space of six data-engineering actions, and show that a corrected single-agent loop reaches only one of them ( Sections 2 and 3 ).

paragraphs.en: The trainer is a single SFT script that runs three epochs, and every recipe within a comparison is capped at the same token budget. Any two rounds therefore differ only in which rows they trained on, and no agent can trade training data for extra rounds. The loop runs until an objective is achieved. Section 3 reports the evidence behind the from-base rule, the fixed budget, and the score target.

paragraphs.en: A recipe is built out of rows, where a row carries an instruction, a response, and the metadata that describes it. An action states which rows to train on, how often each appears, in what order, and whether any row is edited or newly written. Agents write recipes in free form with no field schema, operator list, and statement that a particular kind of change is available.

paragraphs.en: We study how a single agent behaves when it owns an entire SFT data research loop. We reproduce the open-ended PostTrainBench setting [ Rank et al., 2026 ] for Qwen3-1.7B-Base [ Yang et al., 2025 ] on IFEval [ Zhou et al., 2023b ] , in which the agent receives one H100, unrestricted internet access, and a ten-hour wall-clock budget. Six design choices in this setting interfere with measuring what the agent does with data, and we correct them before running the loop: we fix the training algorithm to SFT, provide an initial dataset pool instead of Internet search, add a second benchmark IFBench [ Pyatkin et al., 2025 ] , retrain from the base checkpoint each round, replace the wall-clock allowance with benchmark targets, and return richer feedback including training loss, category-level scores, and per-example failures. Details are deferred to Appendix A .
paragraphs.zh: 我们研究了单个智能体在拥有整个 SFT 数据研究循环时的行为。 我们在 IFEval [Zhou et al., 2023b] 上复现了针对 Qwen3-1.7B-Base [Yang et al., 2025] 的开放型 PostTrainBench 设置 [Rank et al., 2026]，其中智能体配备一台 H100、不受限制的网络访问权限以及十小时的物理时钟预算。 该设置中的六个设计选择会干扰对智能体如何使用数据的测量，因此我们在运行循环前进行了修正：我们将训练算法固定为 SFT，提供初始数据集池而非网络搜索，增加第二个基准测试 IFBench [Pyatkin et al., 2025]，每轮都从基础检查点重新开始训练，用基准测试目标替代物理时钟预算，并返回更丰富的反馈信息，包括训练损失、类别级分数以及每个样本的失败情况。 相关细节已移至附录 A。

paragraphs.en: Time Limits Reduce Per-Round Training Data. The open-ended run is allotted ten hours, and Figure 5 reports the amount of data presented to the trainer in each round. The recipe expands over the first four rounds, reaching 264k rows, and then declines in every subsequent round, ending at 69k rows, which is 26% of the peak. The agent continues to submit rounds throughout, so the run does not terminate early. Rather, it progressively reduces the cost of each remaining round. Once a checkpoint is sufficiently good to retain, additional training data yields no further improvement under the objective, whereas the time it would cost can be used for another attempt. Under benchmark targets, this contraction does not occur: recipe size is around max token budget, and the agent never refers to the remaining time budget.

paragraphs.en: As shown in Section 3.1 , the context of the single-agent loop fills with the verbose logs and outputs of training and evaluation jobs, leaving the information that matters unused. Given this, we introduce an executor, which takes the entire lifecycle of training, checkpoint conversion, and evaluation out of the meta agent and maintains a context of its own. Specifically, everything it does is one cycle of submitting a job, monitoring it to completion, and collecting its artifacts : the cycle runs once on the training job to obtain the round’s model C t C_{t} , and then once on each of the K K benchmarks to obtain the evaluation results for C t C_{t} , with the raw logs and intermediate outputs staying in its own context. When the workflow finishes, the executor saves the feedback artifacts and a structured execution report to files and returns only their paths. The meta agent and the analysis and synthesis subagents can then read the relevant files as needed, without receiving the full execution logs.
paragraphs.zh: 如第 3.1 节所示，单智能体循环的上下文会充斥着训练和评估任务的冗长日志与输出，导致关键信息未被利用。 鉴于此，我们引入一个执行器：它将训练、检查点转换和评估的全生命周期从元智能体中分离出来，并维护一个独立的上下文。 具体而言，其所有操作均遵循一个循环：提交任务、监控任务直至完成，并收集其产物；该循环先对训练任务运行一次以获取本轮的模型 C_t C_{t}，然后对 K K 个基准测试各运行一次以获取 C_t C_{t} 的评估结果，而原始日志和中间输出则保留在其自身的上下文中。 当工作流完成后，执行器会将反馈产物和结构化执行报告保存为文件，并仅返回这些文件的路径。 随后，元智能体以及分析与合成子智能体可根据需要读取相关文件，而无需接收完整的执行日志。

paragraphs.en: The four subagents examine each round using complementary evidence. The learning-dynamics subagent analyzes the training loss and other monitoring signals in F t F_{t} in relation to the data used for training, seeking evidence that explains stalled learning progress. The history subagent reads H < t H_{<t} , distinguishes failed interventions from ideas that have not been adequately tested, and proposes corrections or renewed trials. Each subagent returns one executable data proposal with supporting evidence.

paragraphs.en: In practice, the initial pool D 0 D_{0} may not cover every capability the benchmarks require, and for others it holds examples but too few to constitute effective supervision. We therefore introduce a synthesis subagent to generate examples for undersupplied capability targets. Such a target is convenient to state and to verify in the instruction-following setting: it is a single checkable constraint, or a combination of constraints that co-occur, such as repeating the instruction verbatim while using no comma , and in either case a programmatic verifier decides whether an example satisfies it.
paragraphs.zh: 在实践中，初始池 D₀（D_{0}）可能无法涵盖基准测试所需的所有能力；而对于其他一些能力，虽然其中包含示例，但数量太少，不足以构成有效的监督。 因此，我们引入一个合成子智能体，为那些监督不足的能力目标生成示例。 在指令遵循的场景中，这类目标既便于表述也便于验证：它要么是一个可检查的单一约束条件，要么是同时出现的多个约束条件的组合，例如逐字重复指令且不使用逗号（,）；无论哪种情况，都由程序化的验证器来判断某个示例是否满足该条件。

paragraphs.en: Concretely, the synthesis agent is invoked in every round, reads the evaluation results, and derives a set of targets to strengthen. For each target whose supply in D t D_{t} is insufficient, it synthesizes examples that pass the target’s verifier. If no target is undersupplied in a given round, the synthesis agent generates no data. Generated data pass verification of the target’s constraint, an independent semantic review, and an n n -gram overlap check against the evaluation sets, described in Appendix B.4 . Those that pass enter D t + 1 D_{t+1} , and whether the round trains on them remains the meta agent’s decision.

paragraphs.en: AutoSFT adds three components to the loop of Section 3 , and we test them one at a time. Each subsection compares a base configuration against the same configuration with one component added, so a difference is attributable to that component alone, while Section 5.4 runs the full system on a coding domain to test whether the same structure transfers. Appendix D gives the full implementation settings for every comparison and an estimate of the compute and API cost of a run.
paragraphs.zh: AutoSFT 为第 3 节的循环增加了三个组件，我们将逐一测试它们。 每个子节都将一个基础配置与在相同基础上添加了一个组件的配置进行比较，因此差异可以归因于该单一组件；而第 5.4 节则在一个编码领域上运行完整系统，以测试相同结构是否具备迁移能力。 附录 D 提供了每次比较的全部实现设置，以及对单次运行所需计算资源和 API 成本的估算。

paragraphs.en: Result. Analysis improves the score and reaches higher values earlier. As shown in Figure 8 , the analysis run reaches 63.33 at R6, already above the best score the base run attains in 50 rounds, and climbs to 67.10 at R30. The base run’s best is 60.60 within the first 30 rounds and 62.35 across all 50, so analysis leads by 6.50 points at equal rounds and by 4.75 even when the base run is given 20 rounds more. The two runs also use the data-action families in different proportions ( Figure 8 , right). With analysis, repair and resupervision together account for 55% of the actions taken, whereas the base run stays within the mixture family, adjusting category proportions in every round as the single agent of Section 3.1 does. Neither run writes a new example, which is the subject of Section 5.3 , and neither alters the training order because SFT fixes to a shuffling seed.
paragraphs.zh: 结果。 分析提升了得分，并更早地达到了更高的数值。 如图 8 所示，分析运行在 R6 时达到 63.33，已超过基础运行在 50 轮中取得的最佳得分，并在 R30 时攀升至 67.10。 基础运行在前 30 轮中的最佳得分为 60.60，在所有 50 轮中为 62.35，因此分析在相同轮数下领先 6.50 分，即使基础运行多获得了 20 轮，分析仍领先 4.75 分。 这两种运行对数据-动作族的使用比例也存在差异（图 8，右侧）。 在分析中，修复和重新监督共同占所采取动作的 55%，而基础运行则保持在混合族内，像第 3.1 节的单个智能体一样，在每一轮调整类别比例。 两种运行都没有写入新示例（这是第 5.3 节的主题），也没有改变训练顺序，因为 SFT 已固定为某个洗牌种子。

paragraphs.en: Furthermore, the actions that analysis unlocks often set a new best score, where a new best denotes a recipe that exceeds every earlier score in the same run. Selecting data by validation results sets a new best in 41.7% of its uses, and editing both instructions and answers in 6 of its 14 uses. The base run never takes these actions, since it stays within the mixture family, so Table 4 in Appendix C.1 reports its new-best rate only for mixture. In summary, analysis helps the meta agent read the same evidence in multiple ways, so it can better decide which supervision to change and whether the resulting examples teach the intended behavior.
paragraphs.zh: 此外，分析所触发的操作通常会设定一个新最佳分数，其中“新最佳”指的是在相同运行中超越所有先前分数的配方。 根据验证结果选择数据在其 41.7% 的使用中设定了新最佳，而在其 14 次使用中的 6 次则同时编辑了说明和答案。 基础运行从未执行这些操作，因为它始终保持在混合模型族内，因此附录 C.1 中的表 4 仅报告了其在混合模型下的新最佳率。 总而言之，分析帮助元智能体以多种方式解读相同的证据，从而能更好地决定要更改哪种监督，以及由此产生的示例是否传达了预期的行为。

paragraphs.en: Setup. The base configuration selects from the staged pool and may edit the examples it selects. Adding the synthesis subagent enables a round to generate new examples for a capability, written against that capability’s verifier and admitted to the pool only after passing that verifier. Both runs train from the same base checkpoint for three epochs under a 100M-token cap that counts generated rows, and every checkpoint is evaluated as avg@10 on IFEval and IFBench. The budget is larger than in the previous two comparisons because a smaller budget would keep the pool below its size cap, whereas new data becomes valuable only once selection can no longer improve the recipe.
paragraphs.zh: 设置。 基础配置会从分阶段池中选择示例，并可能编辑所选的示例。 添加合成子智能体后，一轮流程可以为某项能力生成新示例；这些示例会针对该能力的验证器进行编写，且只有在通过验证器后才会被纳入池中。 两次运行均从相同的基础检查点开始训练，持续三个周期，并受限于1亿个标记的上限（生成的行会被计入其中）；每个检查点都会在 IFEval 和 IFBench 上以 avg@10 进行评估。 此次预算高于前两次比较中的预算，因为较小的预算会使池的大小低于其上限，而新数据只有在选择过程无法再改进配方时才会变得有价值。

paragraphs.en: Result. Synthesis improves both benchmarks and reaches higher levels earlier. As shown in Figure 9 (left, middle), the synthesis run reaches a best IFEval of 81.58, compared with 78.15 for the base run, and a best IFBench of 51.95, compared with 49.02. Every IFEval checkpoint from R9 onward exceeds the best checkpoint that the base run attains over 31 rounds. The aggregate gain does not imply that every generated batch helps. paragraphs.en: Setup. To assess whether AutoSFT remains effective beyond instruction following, we evaluate it on code generation with MBPP+ 2 2 2 https://huggingface.co/datasets/evalplus/mbppplus . Unlike IFEval and IFBench, MBPP+ grades only by test execution and carries no capability breakdown, so the system builds its own capability structure from only the benchmark and the pool. The backbone is Qwen3-1.7B-Base with MBPP+ target score 70, and the pool holds 742,842 Python instruction–code pairs from OPC-SFT-Stage2 [ Huang et al., 2025 ] , KodCode-v1-SFT-R1 [ Xu et al., 2025 ] , and Magicoder-OSS-Instruct-75K [ Wei et al., 2024 ] . Each round retrains from the backbone for three epochs at sequence length 8,192 under a 100M-token budget and is evaluated using avg@3. We compare these three configurations: Base, Base + Analysis, and Base + Analysis + Synthesis.

paragraphs.en: Result. Within 64 hours, Base and Base + Analysis each complete 15 rounds and Base + Analysis + Synthesis completes 6 ( Figure 9 , right panel). The single agent shows no sustained improvement, while Base + Analysis produces a consistent upward trend and reaches 64.8% at round 13. Adding synthesis incurs additional runtime per round but reaches 65.8% by round 6. The structure that helped in instruction following transfers to code: multi-agent analysis lifts the recipe above the single agent, and synthesis reaches a comparable peak in fewer rounds.
paragraphs.zh: 结果。 在 64 小时内，Base 和 Base + Analysis 各自完成 15 轮，而 Base + Analysis + Synthesis 完成 6 轮（图 9，右图）。 单一智能体未表现出持续改进，而 Base + Analysis 则呈现出稳定的上升趋势，并在第 13 轮达到 64.8%。 加入合成环节会增加每轮的额外运行时间，但到第 6 轮时已达到 65.8%。 有助于指令遵循的结构也迁移到了代码中：多智能体分析使方案优于单一智能体，而合成环节则在更少的轮次内达到了相当高的峰值。

paragraphs.en: Data selection and synthesis for post-training. Early works show that curation matters more than scale: a small, well-chosen set can match or outperform a much larger one [ Zhou et al., 2023a , Muennighoff et al., 2025 ] , and data ordering alone shapes generalization [ He et al., 2025a ] . Selection methods prune or reweight examples by information gain or diversity [ Agarwal et al., 2025 , Chen et al., 2025 ] . Synthesis methods bootstrap instructions from seed sets, evolve complexity, or extract alignment data from aligned models [ Wang et al., 2023 , Xu et al., 2024a , Xu et al., 2024b , Mitra et al., 2024 , Ren et al., 2026 ] . Some data curation methods also optimize specifically for preference data, curating feedback or preference training pairs [ Cui et al., 2024 , He et al., 2025b , Deng et al., 2025 ] . All produce a fixed dataset without closing the loop on downstream training performance.
paragraphs.zh: 训练后阶段的数据选择与合成。 早期研究表明，数据的质量比规模更为重要：一个经过精心挑选的小型数据集可以媲美甚至超越规模大得多的数据集 [ Zhou et al., 2023a , Muennighoff et al., 2025 ]，而数据的排列顺序本身也会影响模型的泛化能力 [ He et al., 2025a ]。 选择方法通过信息增益或多样性来修剪或重新加权样本 [ Agarwal et al., 2025 , Chen et al., 2025 ]。 合成方法从种子集出发生成指令，逐步提升复杂程度，或者从对齐模型中提取对齐数据 [ Wang et al., 2023 , Xu et al., 2024a , Xu et al., 2024b , Mitra et al., 2024 , Ren et al., 2026 ]。 一些数据整理方法还专门针对偏好数据进行优化，用于整理反馈或偏好训练对 [ Cui et al., 2024 , He et al., 2025b , Deng et al., 2025 ]。 所有这些方法都会生成一个固定的数据集，但并未真正解决下游训练性能的问题。

paragraphs.en: Automated data optimization. A growing body of work attempts to automate data research, closing the loop between data curation and model training. PostTrainBench [ Rank et al., 2026 ] audits 84 agent runs and finds that almost all converge on SFT with data as the sole search object. On the selection side, TREX [ Ma et al., 2026 ] searches recipes via MCTS, AutoSelection [ Wu et al., 2026 ] formalizes operator-program search over a fixed pool, DataChef [ Chen et al., 2026b ] trains a policy with a proxy reward, and Luo et al. [2026] iterates on data alone with gains that plateau after round 8–15. On the synthesis side, Autodata [ Kulikov et al., 2026 ] revises generation strategies from solver feedback, ANDES [ Zhao et al., 2026 ] packages synthesis as a callable skill, and BigBang [ The Endless Frontier Team, 2026 ] scales self-evolving synthesis with a critic proxy. Arbor [ Jin et al., 2026 ] , AutoSOTA [ Li et al., 2026 ] , and the Anthropic automated researcher [ Wen et al., 2026 ] organize research with hypothesis trees, multi-agent decomposition, and diverse initial directions respectively. These systems address either selection or synthesis, while we unify both and retrain from base each round so that every action is individually attributable.
paragraphs.zh: 自动化数据优化。 越来越多的研究尝试将数据研究自动化，从而在数据整理与模型训练之间形成闭环。 PostTrainBench [Rank et al., 2026] 审计了 84 次智能体运行，发现几乎所有运行都以数据为唯一搜索对象，最终收敛于 SFT。 在筛选方面，TREX [Ma et al., 2026] 通过 MCTS 搜索配方，AutoSelection [Wu et al., 2026] 将固定池中的算子编程搜索形式化，DataChef [Chen et al., 2026b] 使用代理奖励训练策略，而 Luo 等人 [2026] 仅对数据进行迭代优化，但收益在第 8–15 轮后趋于平缓。 在合成方面，Autodata [Kulikov et al., 2026] 根据求解器的反馈调整生成策略，ANDES [Zhao et al., 2026] 将合成封装为可调用技能，而 BigBang [The Endless Frontier Team, 2026] 则通过批评代理扩展自演化合成的规模。 Arbor [Jin et al., 2026]、AutoSOTA [Li et al., 2026] 以及 Anthropic 自动化研究员 [Wen et al., 2026] 分别通过假设树、多智能体分解和多样化初始方向来组织研究。 这些系统仅关注筛选或合成，而我们将两者统一，并在每轮中从头重新训练，以确保每个行动都能被单独归因。

paragraphs.en: Benchmarks for AI research. Benchmarks now evaluate agents on ML research tasks at scales from single Kaggle problems to full R&D pipelines [ Chan et al., 2025 , Huang et al., 2024 , Wijk et al., 2025 , Kon et al., 2026 , Zhang et al., 2025 , Lyu et al., 2026 , Garikaparthi et al., 2026 , Xu et al., 2026 ] , on AI infrastructure [ Ouyang et al., 2025 , Chi et al., 2026a , Φ-Bench contributors, 2026 , Yeon et al., 2026 ] , and on self-improvement [ Zhan et al., 2026 , Chi et al., 2026b , Chen et al., 2026a ] . Closest to our setting, DataEnvGym [ Khan et al., 2025 ] frames data generation as an RL loop, Curation-Bench [ Kang et al., 2026 ] gives agents iterative control over a fixed pipeline, and RSIBench-Data [ Meng et al., 2026 ] and DataPrep-Bench [ Liang et al., 2026 ] benchmark data-centric recipe search. We differ by requiring from-base retraining each round, repeated evaluation to bound noise, and a verification gate on synthesis.
paragraphs.zh: 人工智能研究的基准测试。 当前的基准测试从单个 Kaggle 问题到完整的研发流程，评估智能体在机器学习研究任务上的表现 [ Chan et al., 2025 , Huang et al., 2024 , Wijk et al., 2025 , Kon et al., 2026 , Zhang et al., 2025 , Lyu et al., 2026 , Garikaparthi et al., 2026 , Xu et al., 2026 ]，在人工智能基础设施上的表现 [ Ouyang et al., 2025 , Chi et al., 2026a , Φ-Bench contributors, 2026 , Yeon et al., 2026 ]，以及在自我改进方面的表现 [ Zhan et al., 2026 , Chi et al., 2026b , Chen et al., 2026a ]。 与我们设定最接近的包括：DataEnvGym [ Khan et al., 2025 ] 将数据生成框架为强化学习循环；Curation-Bench [ Kang et al., 2026 ] 允许智能体对固定流程进行迭代控制；而 RSIBench-Data [ Meng et al., 2026 ] 和 DataPrep-Bench [ Liang et al., 2026 ] 则对以数据为中心的方案搜索进行基准测试。 我们的不同之处在于：要求每一轮都从基础模型开始重新训练，通过重复评估来限制噪声影响，并对合成结果设置验证关卡。

sents.en: Closest to our setting, DataEnvGym [ Khan et al., 2025 ] frames data generation as an RL loop, Curation-Bench [ Kang et al., 2026 ] gives agents iterative control over a fixed pipeline, and RSIBench-Data [ Meng et al., 2026 ] and DataPrep-Bench [ Liang et al., 2026 ] benchmark data-centric recipe search.

sents.en: We differ by requiring from-base retraining each round, repeated evaluation to bound noise, and a verification gate on synthesis.

paragraphs.en: A single agent owning the full SFT data research loop collapses to one kind of change and loses context repeatedly. AutoSFT adds structure that an executor separates execution from analysis, several analysis subagents propose complementary changes, and a synthesis subagent writes data for uncovered capabilities. Adding each component one at a time under from-base retraining shows that the executor frees the meta agent’s context, analysis broadens changes and improves scores earlier, and synthesis reaches capabilities with almost no data in the pool. The same loop transfers to coding without a ready-made taxonomy, where the system builds its own structure from the benchmark and pool alone. These results suggest that the bottleneck may not be any single action but the structure that lets an agent cover the full range of data-engineer changes, and that multi-agent decomposition is a practical way to provide it.
paragraphs.zh: 单个智能体若完全掌控 SFT 数据研究循环，其变化将趋于单一，并反复失去上下文语境。 AutoSFT 引入了一种结构：执行者将执行与分析分离，多个分析子智能体提出互补的变化，而合成子智能体则为尚未覆盖的能力生成数据。 在基于基础模型重新训练的过程中，逐个添加每个组件表明：执行者释放了元智能体的上下文语境，分析环节能更早地拓展变化并提升分数，而合成环节则几乎无需池中的数据即可实现所需能力。 同样的循环机制也适用于编码场景，即便没有现成的分类体系，系统也能仅凭基准测试和数据池自行构建结构。 这些结果表明，瓶颈可能并非某个单一操作，而是能让智能体覆盖数据工程师全部变化范围的结构；而多智能体分解正是实现这一目标的一种实用方法。

paragraphs.en: Deciding what data a round needs is easier when the benchmark already says what it is testing. Instruction following does say so. Its prompts carry constraints of known kinds, and a benchmark that groups them lets a weak group be read directly off the scores, after which the agent can raise that group’s share, label existing rows by the capability they teach, or ask for new rows aimed at it. Most domains do not come with such a grouping, and we did not want a system that only works where one exists. The meta agent therefore builds and maintains the grouping itself. It starts from whatever structure the benchmark provides, which for instruction following is the published constraint types, and extends it as rounds expose distinctions the original grouping did not make. When a benchmark provides nothing, the agent derives the groups from the failures it observes. Every leaf of the resulting taxonomy is a requirement a program can decide, such as answering without using a comma, and carries the program that decides it. Rows in the pool are labelled by the leaves they satisfy, which is what allows the meta agent to select data by capability rather than by source and gives the synthesis subagent stable names to write against. The taxonomy is rebuilt for a new domain, and Section 5.4 reports how far that rebuilding got.

paragraphs.en: Registering the hypothesis first is what makes it worth recording. A round states the data change it plans, why that change should move the metric, the round its result will be compared against, the direction it expects, and the finer observation that would show the change working as intended. The submission path refuses a round whose hypothesis was never written down. A prediction written after the results are known can always be adjusted to fit them, which is what the ordering prevents.
paragraphs.zh: 首先记录假设，正是这一点使其值得被记载。 一个回合会声明其计划的数据变更、为何该变更应能推动指标、其结果将被与哪个结果进行比较、其预期的方向，以及能够显示该变更按预期生效的更细致的观察。 提交流程会拒绝那些假设从未被写下来的回合。 在已知结果之后写下的预测总能被调整以符合这些结果，而顺序规定正是为了防止这种情况。

paragraphs.en: A verdict is read on two separate questions. The first asks what the benchmark mean did against the comparison round, judged only as a direction and only against the variation measured between repeated rounds. The second asks whether the finer observation actually appeared in the evaluation outputs. Keeping them apart matters because they can disagree, and a disagreement is informative. A score that rose without its intended effect appearing has some other cause, and an effect that appeared without a score change means the slice it touched was too small or a loss elsewhere cancelled it.
paragraphs.zh: 针对两个独立问题宣读判决结果。 第一个问题是：基准模型在与对比轮次的比较中表现如何？判断仅基于方向性，且仅依据重复轮次间测得的差异。 第二个问题是：更精细的观察结果是否确实出现在评估输出中。 将两者分开很重要，因为它们的结果可能不一致，而这种不一致本身具有信息价值。 如果得分上升但预期效果并未出现，则另有原因；如果效果出现了而得分未变，说明其影响范围过小，或别处的损失抵消了该效果。

paragraphs.en: What a verdict leaves behind is a short statement of what it means for later rounds. A later round may disagree with an earlier statement by saying so in its own entry. paragraphs.en: Target selection checks data supply rather than relying on aggregate capability scores alone. The subagent selects a target when the pool contains far fewer than the 1000 rows it treats as sufficient, and it records the count it finds. For example, the R9 targets matched only 4 to 161 staged rows each. The subagent excluded capabilities that already had ample data, reasoning that generating new examples cannot help a capability the pool already covers. A capability with a high aggregate score can therefore still be a target, because what is scarce is a specific constraint combination rather than the capability as a whole. An example is repetition together with a number word, as opposed to number words on their own. The score of an exact combination cannot be measured directly, because the benchmark contains at most one question for it. The comparison in Figure 16 is therefore made at the aggregate capability level.
paragraphs.zh: 目标选择会检查数据供给情况，而不仅仅是依赖综合能力得分。 当数据池中包含的行数远少于其视为充足的 1000 行时，子智能体就会选择一个目标，并记录实际找到的行数。 例如，R9 的目标每次仅匹配到 4 至 161 个已准备的数据行。 子智能体排除了那些已有充足数据的综合能力，理由是生成新示例无法帮助数据池中已覆盖的能力。 因此，即使某种综合能力得分很高，它仍可能成为目标，因为稀缺的是特定的约束组合，而非该能力本身。 一个例子是重复操作与数字词的结合，而不是单独的数字词。 精确组合的得分无法直接衡量，因为基准测试中最多只包含一道相关的题目。 因此，图 16 中的比较是在综合能力层面进行的。

paragraphs.en: Resource usage. We estimate the cost of a research run from the synthesis experiment, which uses the largest per-round budget of 100M tokens. Each round prepares data under agent guidance, fine-tunes one recipe, and evaluates the resulting checkpoint. Training takes about 0.8 0.8 GPU-hours per round on 8 H800 GPUs and evaluation about 0.15 0.15 GPU-hours on one, so a 20-round run costs roughly 130 GPU-hours. The research agent and the generation backend together consume about 2.6 × 10 8 2.6\times 10^{8} tokens per round, counting input, output, and reasoning tokens, for an estimated API cost near USD 95 per round, or USD 1,900 over the run. The paper reports about ten distinct runs and a few hundred rounds in total, counting a shared baseline once. Scaling each experiment by its token budget gives an order-of-magnitude total of 10 3 10^{3} GPU-hours and USD 10 4 10^{4} , with real usage varying by hardware utilization, evaluation protocol, and agent activity.
paragraphs.zh: 资源使用。 我们根据合成实验估算一次研究运行的成本，该实验每轮使用的最大预算为 100M 个 token。 每一轮都在智能体的指导下准备数据、微调一个配方，并评估生成的检查点。 在 8 块 H800 GPU 上，每轮训练大约需要 0.8 GPU-小时，在一块 GPU 上评估大约需要 0.15 GPU-小时，因此一次包含 20 轮的运行成本约为 130 GPU-小时。 研究智能体和生成后端每轮总共消耗约 2.6 × 10⁸ 个 token（包括输入、输出和推理 token），预计 API 成本接近每轮 95 美元，整个运行总成本为 1,900 美元。 该论文报告了大约十次独立的运行和总共数百轮实验，其中共享的基线仅计算一次。 根据每个实验的 token 预算进行缩放，总量级约为 10³ GPU-小时和 10⁴ 美元，实际使用量会因硬件利用率、评估协议和智能体活动而异。

paragraphs.en: All results are obtained on one base model at one scale (Qwen3-1.7B-Base), so the effects we report may not hold at other scales, and a capability this model cannot learn from more data may be learnable by a larger one. Each comparison runs one search per configuration, and although repeated evaluation bounds the noise of a single checkpoint, it does not bound the variation between independent searches. Synthesis raises the aggregate score through a small number of learnable capabilities that the pool undersupplies, and it does not move capabilities the model cannot yet follow. The generalization study covers a single new domain with short runs, so it demonstrates that the loop can transfer but does not establish how broadly.
paragraphs.zh: 所有结果均基于单一规模（Qwen3-1.7B-Base）的一个基础模型获得，因此我们报告的效果在其他规模上可能并不成立；此外，该模型无法通过更多数据学习到的能力，或许能被更大规模的模型所掌握。 每次比较对每种配置仅执行一次搜索；尽管重复评估可以限制单个检查点的噪声，但无法限制独立搜索之间的差异。 合成过程通过少数几个池中供给不足的可学习能力来提升总分值，而模型尚无法遵循的能力则不会因此发生变动。 泛化研究仅涵盖一个通过短期运行测试的新领域，因此它证明了该循环可以迁移，但并未说明其迁移范围有多广。
